cells.reason: Subsumed cell: derived value is the parent tHg value, 300 ug/kg wet weight from EU 2023/915 Annex I 3.3.1.3, and the species-to-total bound MeHg <= tHg is arithmetically sound. It is refuted only because it inherits the parent's scope defect: the 0.30 mg/kg row covers carp, Oncorhynchus/Salmo (non-trutta) trout and Pangasius catfish but not tilapia, other catfish or brown trout, for which the sovereign tHg row is eu2023_hg_fish_general_500 (Annex I 3.3.1.1), so the parent is not a firm sovereign number for the whole product form as defined; once the parent is re-tagged or split the bound at 300 stands. No MeHg-specific same-basis row is stricter (MX NOM-242 'other fishery products', TH, PH, TT, VN, HK Cap 132V 'fish other than those specified' and GB 2762-2025 'aquatic animals excluding predatory fish' all sit at 500).
